But, although safely concealed from the eyes of men, Danae was plainly seen by the everlasting gods; and Jupiter, looking down from Olympus, beheld her in all her loveliness and in all her loneliness.
Jupiter, pitying her isolation and admiring her beauty, resolved to go down and converse with her for a little while.
